content.title: BankFinancial and its 18 mostly suburban Chicago branches sold for $142 million to First Financial
content.summary: Cincinnati-based First Financial has agreed to buy BankFinancial, a century-old Burr Ridge-based bank, in an all-stock deal valued at $142 million. BankFinancial, which opened its doors in 1924 as Oakley Federal Savings in Chicago, has 18 mostly suburban locations in Cook, Cook, DuPage, Lake and Will Counties.
